title: Nestlé North America — Where JUBAP Was Named
context:
## Nestlé North America — Where JUBAP Was Named
El caso permite examinar cómo una intervención se integró en prácticas de mejora, mantenimiento y gestión ya presentes. La atención al punto de bloqueo ayuda a relacionar marcos que por separado explicaban solo una parte del problema.
Etiquetas: Aprendizaje y transmisión de capacidades 22.22%; Empresa y gestión 55.56%; Evidencia, procedencia y atribución 22.22%
Ficha: https://dakleyer.github.io/perspective-beyond/constelacion/#ficha-nestle
Documento de origen: https://jubap.eu/nestle-case-study-where-jubap-was-first-named/

relations.title: Tiger Team Maturity Model
relations.reading: The Nestlé account describes codification and internal facilitator training, practices that can be compared with repeatability and learning in the maturity model.

relations.title: The Coordination Entropy Trap in Large Scale Programs
relations.reading: The liberation strategy and compressed accountability both focus attention, but operate through different social and organizational mechanisms.

relations.title: The JUBAP Framework
relations.reading: The Nestlé account describes how the dashboard, liberation strategy and six-domain root-cause tool were used as a sequence.

relations.title: Measuring Human Intelligence Debt
relations.reading: A future evaluation could separate the cost of building facilitator capability from any later reduction in compensatory coordination work.

relations.title: The Attribution Gap and Capability Loss
relations.reading: Facilitator capability can outlast an intervention only if learning is accompanied by durable ownership, resourcing and recognition, rather than enthusiasm alone.

relations.title: Information Management as Operational Tracking
relations.reading: Resistance indicators can focus investigation, while capability and critical-path analysis are needed to distinguish a causal bottleneck from a visible symptom.

relations.title: Barcelona, Cuba, California, Veracruz: Urban Mobility, Swarm Intelligence and Constraint-Driven Architecture
relations.reading: Tuxpan's adoption layer can be compared with JUBAP's internal facilitation model: the operating practice must become usable and transmissible inside the receiving organization.
